coverageNote: The current seed dataset covers the full official fixture skeleton from June 11 through July 19. Rich previews, scores, live status and knockout participants are updated progressively.

headline.en: Messi leads all scorers with five World Cup goals
headline.zh: 梅西以5球领跑世界杯射手榜

body.en: Lionel Messi's brace against Austria lifted him to five goals from Argentina's first two matches.
body.zh: 利昂内尔·梅西对奥地利的梅开二度，让他在阿根廷前两场比赛后达到5球。

standouts.en: He sits alone at the top of the Golden Boot race after following his opening hat trick with another decisive night.
standouts.zh: 他在首战帽子戏法后又打出决定性表现，独自领跑金靴奖竞争。
